cet4.exampleEn: The soldiers were ordered to abandon their post.
cet4.exampleZh: 士兵们接到命令放弃他们的阵地。

cet4.exampleEn: She is a strong candidate for the job.
cet4.exampleZh: 她是这个职位的强有力候选人。

cet4.exampleEn: Self-discipline is essential for learning online.
cet4.exampleZh: 自律对于在线学习至关重要。

cet4.exampleEn: Modern technology makes our work much more efficient.
cet4.exampleZh: 现代技术使我们的工作效率大为提高。

cet4.exampleEn: Hard work alone cannot guarantee success, but it helps.
cet4.exampleZh: 单凭努力不能保证成功，但很有帮助。

cet4.exampleEn: Do not hesitate to contact us if you need help.
cet4.exampleZh: 如果您需要帮助，请随时联系我们。

cet4.exampleEn: The teacher used examples to illustrate the point.
cet4.exampleZh: 老师用例子来说明这一点。

cet4.exampleEn: It is important to maintain a healthy lifestyle.
cet4.exampleZh: 保持健康的生活方式非常重要。

cet4.exampleEn: It is obvious that she has practiced a lot.
Her persistent efforts yielded great results.
cet4.exampleZh: 她坚持不懈的努力取得了巨大成果。

cet4.exampleEn: He was reluctant to leave his hometown.
cet4.exampleZh: 他不情愿离开他的家乡。

cet4.exampleEn: We have sufficient evidence to support our claim.
cet4.exampleZh: 我们有足够的证据支持我们的主张。

cet4.exampleEn: This is only a temporary solution to the problem.
cet4.exampleZh: 这只是问题的临时解决方法。

cet4.exampleEn: Our ultimate goal is to achieve peace.
cet4.exampleZh: 我们的最终目标是实现和平。

cet4.exampleEn: Children are particularly vulnerable to diseases.
cet4.exampleZh: 儿童特别容易受到疾病的侵袭。

cet6.exampleEn: Many experts advocate for sustainable energy solutions.
cet6.exampleZh: 许多专家倡导使用可持续能源解决方案。

cet6.exampleEn: The report provides a comprehensive review of the market.
cet6.exampleZh: 该报告对市场进行了全面的审查。

cet6.exampleEn: There is a subtle difference between the two terms.
cet6.exampleZh: 这两个术语之间存在细微的区别。

cet6.exampleEn: The weather conditions began to deteriorate rapidly.
cet6.exampleZh: 天气状况开始迅速恶化。

cet6.trans: 以经验为依据的，实证的
cet6.exampleEn: The theory is based on empirical data collected over years.
cet6.exampleZh: 该理论基于多年收集的实证数据。

cet6.exampleEn: Their working styles were completely incompatible.
cet6.exampleZh: 他们的工作风格完全不兼容。

cet6.exampleEn: Careless mistakes could jeopardize the whole project.
cet6.exampleZh: 粗心的错误可能会危及整个项目。

cet6.exampleEn: He left his teaching job for a lucrative career in business.
cet6.exampleZh: 他辞去了教职，转而从事获利丰厚的商业事业。

cet6.exampleEn: She performed her research with meticulous attention to detail.
cet6.exampleZh: 她以对细节的极高关注开展研究。

cet6.exampleEn: This court ruling sets an important precedent.
cet6.exampleZh: 这一法庭裁决树立了一个重要的先例。

kaoyan.trans: 模棱两可的，含糊不清的
kaoyan.exampleEn: The instructions were ambiguous and caused confusion.
kaoyan.exampleZh: 这些指令含糊不清，引起了混乱。

kaoyan.exampleEn: Online shopping has become prevalent worldwide.
kaoyan.exampleZh: 网上购物在全球范围内已变得非常普遍。

kaoyan.exampleEn: Her holiday coincided with the national festival.
kaoyan.exampleZh: 她的假期正好赶上了国家节日。

kaoyan.exampleEn: Smoking has a detrimental effect on human health.
kaoyan.exampleZh: 吸烟对人类健康有危害作用。

kaoyan.exampleEn: Flexibility is an intrinsic quality of rubber.
kaoyan.exampleZh: 弹性是橡胶的固质特性。

ielts.exampleEn: Temperatures fluctuate wildly in the desert at night.
ielts.exampleZh: 沙漠里的气温在夜间大幅波动。

ielts.exampleEn: The company reported a substantial increase in profits.
ielts.exampleZh: 该公司报告利润大幅增加。

ielts.exampleEn: The council decided to allocate resources to public health.
ielts.exampleZh: 议会决定将资源分配给公共卫生领域。

ielts.trans: 有凝聚力的，紧密结合的
ielts.exampleEn: A cohesive team works effectively together.
ielts.exampleZh: 一支有凝聚力的团队可以高效合作。

ielts.exampleEn: English is the predominant language in international commerce.
ielts.exampleZh: 英语是国际商业占主导地位的语言。
